description: This file defines the 'AttendanceConfiguration' class within the 'OrangeHRM\Attendance\Dto' namespace. The class manages attendance configuration settings with private boolean properties and corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: AttendanceConfiguration
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class that encapsulates configuration options related to user permissions for attendance management, such as changing current time, modifying attendance, and supervisor modifications.

methods.name: canUserChangeCurrentTime
methods.description: Getter method that returns whether the user can change the current time.

methods.name: setCanUserChangeCurrentTime
methods.description: Setter method to set the permission for the user to change the current time.

methods.name: canUserModifyAttendance
methods.description: Getter method that returns whether the user can modify attendance.

methods.name: setCanUserModifyAttendance
methods.description: Setter method to set the permission for the user to modify attendance.

methods.name: canSupervisorModifyAttendance
methods.description: Getter method that returns whether a supervisor can modify attendance.

methods.name: setCanSupervisorModifyAttendance
methods.description: Setter method to set the permission for supervisor to modify attendance.
